address.ask: Empower Web API address, from your Empower administrator
address.help: Waters installs the Web API as a service on the Empower server, commonly on port 3076. Open the address in a browser: a certificate warning is fine, a timeout is not.

username.ask: Empower user the agent logs in as
username.help: A dedicated Empower user with rights to the project and to the project Mobile, to create sample set methods and to run samples. No rights to edit or delete methods or results.

project.ask: Empower project the agent works in
project.help: The project name exactly as Empower shows it.

node.ask: Acquisition node (the LAC/E or PC name as Empower shows it)

export_dir.ask: Folder where Empower's export method writes results
export_dir.help: Optional. Give the processing method an export method that writes CSV to a shared folder, and name that folder here; job results then include the exported rows.

service.ask: Empower service name (Enter for the default)

verify_tls.ask: Check the Web API's TLS certificate?
